description: SPM LTDS Appendix 4 Fault Levels (Table 4) 132kV 1ph - copy is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The "SPM LTDS Appendix 4 Fault Levels (Table 4) 132kV 1ph" dataset provides plant fault levels for the distribution system as at the data freeze date. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). Its keywords are SPM, LTDS, Long Term Development Statement, Fault Level, Short-circuit, 132kV. The portal shows 2023-11-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
